content.text: Let me get the page link URLs and fetch all pages via eval.

input.command: orca eval --expression "(async()=>{const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')].map(a=>a.href);const urls=[location.href,...new Set(links)];const rows=[];const seen=new Set();for(const u of urls){const t=await (await fetch(u)).text();const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,'text/html');for(const tr of d.querySelectorAll('tbody tr, table tr')){const c=[...tr.querySelectorAll('td')].map(x=>x.textContent.trim());if(c.length>=4&&!seen.has(c[0])){seen.add(c[0]);rows.push(c)}}}const m=rows.filter(r=>r[1]==='Northwind'&&r[3]==='overdue');return JSON.stringify({links:[...new Set(links)],n:rows.length,m,sum:m.reduce((s,r)=>s+Math.round(parseFloat(r[2].replace(/[$,]/g,''))*100),0)/100})})()\" --json

input.command: orca eval --expression '(async()=>{const links=[...document.querySelectorAll("a")].map(a=>a.href);const urls=[location.href,...new Set(links)];const rows=[];const seen=new Set();for(const u of urls){const t=await (await fetch(u)).text();const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,"text/html");for(const tr of d.querySelectorAll("tr")){const c=[...tr.querySelectorAll("td")].map(x=>x.textContent.trim());if(c.length>=4&&!seen.has(c[0])){seen.add(c[0]);rows.push(c)}}}const m=rows.filter(r=>r[1]==="Northwind"&&r[3]==="overdue");return JSON.stringify({links:[...new Set(links)],n:rows.length,m,variants:[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r[1]+"|"+r[3]))],sum:m.reduce((s,r)=>s+Math.round(parseFloat(r[2].replace(/[$,]/g,""))*100),0)/100})})()' --json
